name: vera-multi
description: Vera Multi monorepo — корневые скрипты для запуска/перезапуска сервера и веб-клиента одной командой.

scripts.install-all: cd Server && npm install && cd ../Web && npm install
scripts.kill: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"CommandLine LIKE '%vite%'\" | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.restart: npm run kill && npm run start
scripts.start: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit','-Command','cd Server; npm start'; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit','-Command','cd Web; npm run dev'"
